name: pr-review-workflow
description: Reviews a GitHub pull request end to end: posts inline findings, edits the branch to address them, re-reviews until clean, then merges or asks.

auto_approve.title: Auto-approve on convergence
auto_approve.description: Merge automatically once the review loop finds nothing open. When off, the plugin asks before merging.

check_command.title: Check command
check_command.description: The reviewed repository's own check command. It proves suggested changes before they post, and gates each editing round: fixes must leave it passing. Leave empty to skip both.

double_review.title: Second review pass
double_review.description: When a gap pass runs after the first review: off, risky (secrets or automation probes fired, or the diff is large), or always. The gap pass reads the existing findings and reports only what they miss.

local_standards.title: Local standards files
local_standards.description: Space-separated globs, relative to your clone, of untracked files holding the project's own rules and standards. Their substance guides every review; their names and text never reach the pull request. Leave empty for projects without them.

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Model for the first thorough review. Use inherit for the session model.

editor_model.title: Editor model
editor_model.description: Model for the agent that addresses findings. Use inherit for the session model.

verifier_model.title: Verifier model
verifier_model.description: Model for re-review passes that only verify prior findings.
